subject.title: [Bug]: Secret provider crash-loop exhausts 1Password service account rate limits

question: What startup SecretRef failure policy should OpenClaw ship for exec-backed external providers under supervisor restarts?
rationale: Changing startup fail-fast behavior can reduce provider rate-limit amplification, but it also changes credential failure semantics and operator visibility for security-sensitive SecretRef resolution.

options.title: Bounded generic retry plus guidance
options.body: Add owner-approved bounded startup retry/backoff for transient SecretRef provider failures, keep hard failure after exhaustion, and document supervisor restart-storm limits.

options.title: Degraded startup or circuit breaker
options.body: Allow the gateway to stay up with unavailable SecretRef-backed surfaces disabled, accepting a larger behavior and security-policy change.

options.title: Docs/plugin path only
options.body: Keep core fail-fast behavior and steer batching, caching, and rate-limit handling to external resolver plugins plus operational docs.

recommendation.title: Bounded generic retry plus guidance
recommendation.body: Add owner-approved bounded startup retry/backoff for transient SecretRef provider failures, keep hard failure after exhaustion, and document supervisor restart-storm limits.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant has the strongest feature-history link to the SecretRef runtime and startup activation behavior that the decision would change.
